# Definition colon

Short definitions keep the `:=` intact and spaced as one relation.

$$
a:=b
$$

An assignment-led relation chain aligns repeated assignments under the first
operator and other relations under its right-hand side; `:=` stays intact.

\[
\hat{\mu}_{\textrm{MC}}   := \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N h(X_i)
          \rightarrow \mu := \E(h(X_1))
                           = \int h(x) f(x) \ \mathrm{d}x
\]
